title.en: An Act Increasing the Salaries of Officers and Employees of the Office of the Solicitor General and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Salaries of Officers and Employees of the Office of the Solicitor General and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6458_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Any provision of existing law, executive order, rule or regulations to the contrary notwithstanding, the annual salaries of the officers and employees of the Office of the Solicitor General occupying positions mentioned in this section shall be adjusted as follows:
Title of positions Annual Salary Administrative Officer P12,000 Administrative Assistant 10,800 Budget Officer 10,800 Research Attorney and Chief Librarian.
9,600 Private Secretary 6,552 Cashier and Disbursing Officer 10,200 Supply Officer 8,400 Supervising Stenographer 8,400 Stenographic Reporter 7,236 Records Officer 9,000 Assistant Records Officer 7,800 Chief, Docket Division 10,800 Assistant Chief, Docket Division (Senior Clerk) 9,756 Collecting Officer (Cash Clerk) 6,240 Clerk 5,400 Chief, Criminal Case Section.
8,400 Assistant Chief, Criminal Case Section 7,200 (Item No. 52-2, RA 6130, p. 346) Chief, Civil Case Section 8,400 Assistant Chief, Civil Case Section 7,200 (Item No. 52-7), RA 6130, p. 346 Chief, Land Registration Case Section 8,400 Assistant Chief, Land Registration Case Section 7,200 (Item No. 36-1, RA 6130, p. 346) Senior Stenographers 6,600 Assistant Supply Officer 6,240 Statistician.
5,376 Section Chief (Clerk II) 8,400 Clerk-Filer 4,404 Assistant Budget Officer 7,200 Assistant Librarian.
6,600 Messengers 3,984 Head Janitor with Quarters 4,200 Janitor 3,792 Clerical Aide 3,984 Duplicating Machine Operator 4,200 Confidential Secretary 11,000 Assistant Chief Librarian and Liaison Officer 9,000 (Item No. 41, RA 6130, p. 346) Stitcher 3,984 Accountant 9,600 Budget Analyst 8,400 (Item No. 45-7, RA 6130, p. 346) Bookkeeper 7,200 Ledger Clerk 4,800 Clerk-Typist 4,800 Senior Clerk-Typist 5,400 (Item No. 58-9-1, RA 6130, p. 346) Six Laborers (new) 3,792 Six Stitchers (new) 3,984 Electrician and Mechanic 4,188

Upon approval of this Act, the respective officer or employee actually occupying any of these positions hereinabove mentioned shall be entitled to the salary provided for the said position without need of a new appointment.

The salary differential resulting from the adjustment in the salaries as provided in this Act shall be paid proportionately out of the savings and twenty per cent of the income of the Office of the Solicitor General for the fiscal year when this Act is approved. Thereafter, the necessary funds needed to implement the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, June 17, 1972.
